description: KNaMg₁₄O₁₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmm2 space group. K is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.76 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.35 Å. There are ten inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.22 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.37 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.28 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with seven MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.24 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.11 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.31 Å. In the seventh Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.43 Å. In the eighth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.24 Å. In the ninth Mg site, Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-15°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.23 Å. In the tenth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with nine MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-14°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.39 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one K and five Mg atoms to form distorted OKMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four OKMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-20°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve OKMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-11°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent K and four Mg atoms to form OK₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with ten OKNaMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-29°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-17°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one K, one Na, and four Mg atoms to form OKNaMg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OKNaMg₄ octahedra and edges with eleven ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-29°. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OKNaMg₄ octahedra and edges with eleven ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-19°.
